description: Verify a batch of caller-assigned transaction labels (up to 100) against CryptoTaxEdge's deterministic classification basis: rules, the verified cache and the answer guards, with no model call. Returns per row a verdict (agree, disagree, unverifiable), the engine's cte_category, cte_treatment and cte_taxable when known, confidence (a routing signal, not an accuracy claim), evidence (the checks run: label mapping, basis, legs vs on-chain transfers, label vs token flows, protocol registry, taxability, calibration), a suggested_fill and a machine-readable dispute (dispute_id, failed check, evidence, how to contest, review_sla_hours) on disagree, and a reason with fill_available on unverifiable. A row with no deterministic basis is unverifiable and free; pass fill=true on that row to run the classification engine on it (that row is then a fill). Labels are read in the Standard vocabulary (https://cryptotaxedge.com/standard/#categories), the served ledger-action labels, and the Koinly and CoinTracker export vocabularies; an unmapped label is unverifiable (label_unmapped), never best-effort matched. Verify does not decide tax treatment beyond the published Standard and does not file.

fill.description: (Optional, default false) default for rows that do not set fill.

caller_label.description: The label you assigned: a Standard category (swap, reward, transfer, ...), a served ledger action (Trade, Income, ...), or a Koinly or CoinTracker export label.

caller_taxable.description: (Optional) the taxability you assigned. When given it is checked against the house treatment (and the Standard's alternate treatment on grey-area categories).

chain.description: Chain slug (e.g. "ethereum", "polygon", "base", "arbitrum", "solana"). Optional on the major networks (auto-detected); pass it for other chains.

fill.description: (Optional, default false) run the classification engine when no deterministic basis exists. That row is then billed as a fill (1.0) instead of free.

label_vocabulary.description: (Optional) pin which vocabulary the label is in. Without it the Standard is read first; a word that exists in two vocabularies with different meanings (Koinly "swap") is reported as a collision.

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash (0x-prefixed 66-char for EVM, base-58 for Solana).

tx_id.description: (Optional) your own row id; echoed back as id.

wallet.description: (Optional) 0x wallet whose perspective the legs are read from.

name: verify_batch

confidence.description: Routing signal, not an accuracy claim.

dispute.description: On disagree: dispute_id, failed_check, failed_checks, evidence, contest { how, review_sla_hours }.

evidence.description: checks[] (name, pass, detail), label_map, legs, guard, registry, calibration.

reason.description: On unverifiable: label_missing, label_unmapped, no_deterministic_basis, engine_routed_to_review, low_confidence, tx_not_found, basis_error, budget_exhausted, invalid_hash, invalid_input, chain_unsupported.

suggested_fill.description: On disagree: the engine category, treatment, taxable, ledger_action, confidence, description.

title: Verify caller labels
